title: 卖Notion模板月入2万美金，你也可以
carouselChartTitle: 卖Notion模板月入2万美金，你也可以
author: 阿星
content:
**发布时间：2024-06-21**

你有没有想过，卖模板能赚多少钱？

Modest Midkus靠卖Notion模板，月入2-3万美金。

他怎么做到的？

答案可能比你想象的简单：

SEO。

## 关键词的力量

最近Tony看到Modest Midkus的一条推。

对于那些不熟悉的人，Modest是个数字创作者，

有几个在线生意，一个是关于如何建数字产品的课程，

另一个是卖Notion模板。

Modest大约月入2-3万美金卖这些Notion模板。

但他怎么做到的？

**SEO（搜索引擎优化）**

在推中，Modest分享了他网站过去2个月的SEO统计。

他在 target 关键词"notion templates"，

从4月2日到6月13日，这个关键词的统计如下：

总点击：4,275
总展示：135,394

所以本质上每月大约有6万+人在Google上搜索notion templates，

其中大约2千+每月点击他的网站。

Strange thing about this is he isn't even ranking in the top 10 on Google for this keyword！

So what does this mean？

Basically Modest has found a keyword that has high search volumes each month

and he has optimized his website for it

（as in he mentions the keyword in a few key areas on the website）

and from that he is getting huge traffic coming into his website each month

and he is converting that traffic into customers。

This is all happening even though he isn't ranking in the top 10 on Google

（his website pathpages.com is around about the 14 mark if you search for "notion templates"）。

## 如何复制

Here's how you can too。

Tony发现可以 target 低难度（meaning it's easy to rank high on Google）

和高搜索量（meaning lots of people are searching for the keyword every month）的 startup ideas。

他找到了一个和Modest做的很相似的，看看你怎么想。

**So what's the idea？**

Notion Template Marketplace

"A platform that offers a wide range of customizable Notion templates

for different industries and use cases。

Users can browse，purchase，and download templates

to enhance their Notion workspace and increase efficiency。"

**What keywords can I target？**

Keyword：best notion templates
Keyword Difficulty：19
Average Search Volume：1000 per month

Keyword：notion templates aesthetic
Keyword Difficulty：24
Average Search Volume：1600 per month

Keyword：notion calendar templates
Keyword Difficulty：19
Average Search Volume：880 per month

Keyword：notion journaling templates
Keyword Difficulty：22
Average Search Volume：720 per month

## Takeaway

If you have an idea for an online business and want to get customers

then find keywords that you can target that are easy to rank in Google for

and have high search volumes。

Modest gets these customers on autopilot without promoting his notion templates too much。

Who doesn't want that？

Sales while you sleep is always a good thing！

You might say ok but there's already loads of Notion Template Marketplace's。

If you look on Google you will see a few

but that shouldn't let it stop you。

Just because something already exists doesn't mean you won't be successful。

Competitors are a good thing

and it's why those 4 keywords have high search volumes

but the key thing to know is all those keywords have a low keyword difficulty，

meaning it is easy to rank high in Google for them

so there is big potential here！

*原文来源：Indie Hackers - Tony from Find Micro Saas Ideas*
